status: Protocol/source to be committed before E09 benchmark computation
scope: Fixed-setting factorial development on16 consulted families and same48 E08 training-pool outerfolds. No new inner selection, new original outer-test scoring or independent confirmation.
controls: E08 matched NN5 geometric,KMeans++,Bisecting at same seeds plus a random one-start20-iteration paper20 constructor. U paper20 groups on unweighted training-scaled features; G paper20 uses weighted Euclidean features and is explicitly an adaptation. Allp5 always queries unweighted min-max-scaled coordinates with Minkowski5 and inverse-distance softmax; therefore G denotes construction-only for allp5, while NN5 uses G for both construction and query. No claim these two readout blocks differ in only one metric or mechanism.
selection: No selection this round: all fixed budgets and both readout blocks reported. Do not pick a best point or reinterpret consulted folds as independent confirmation.
training_refit: Fit scaling,bandwidths,KL weights and calibration on each outer-fit only. No inner selection this stage. Masks depend on fixed seeds/costs. Full fitting features used even for cost40; not60% complete training acquisition savings.
evaluation: Freeze all48 prediction bundles before one scoring pass. Compare constructors within same exactK,geometry,readout,alpha; compare readout blocks on identical prototype groups. No original external-test scoring.
aggregation: Pool3outerfold squared-error sums per family. Equal-weight16families; folds, masks, caps and budgets do not become independent datasets. Report all families and all settings; no best point headline.
primary_diagnostics: KMeans++ and Bisecting minus geometric at sameK under each readout
Allp5 minus NN5 on identicalgroups for every constructor
U/paper20/K5 native anchor and its same-readout capacity curves
secondary_diagnostics: G minus U construction for allp5; not queried Gweight
exact E08 common NN5/native anchor replay
repair and warning counts for each outer construction
reporting: Descriptive means, family win/tie/loss and selected capacity. Brier ties use absdiff<=1e-12. No significance claim on the already consulted development families. Training array capacity excludes Python overhead, fitting memory,serialization. Full endpoint equals singleton predictor.
freeze_boundary: Source, protocol and synthetic checks committed before E09 benchmark execution; data previously consulted and cached. All48 predictions frozen before scoring. Not registry preregistration.
constructor_seeds: Exactly E08 outer construction seeds for common methods/budgets. paper20 uses E08 nativeLDLKM seedbase+700000+mask for allbudgets, modulo2**32. K5 is min(5,nfit); percentageK=max(1,floor(percent*nfit/100)).
exactK_and_duplicates: Shared E08 exactK convention: singleton groups atK=n; if distinct selected weighted feature vectors<K, library fits at min(K,distinct) and deterministic largest-group repair supplies exactK. Repaired paper20 variants are adaptations; native anchor only compared when repair_count=0. Both readouts receive same canonical member groups. All cases/repairs retained.

native_LDLKM.implementation_disclosures: Training-only min-max scaling, sklearn1.8.0 Lloyd random initialization, tol1e-4 and fixed seed; these are explicit implementation choices, not claimed verbatim paper specifications. Feature and label means per nonempty cluster. Softmax of inverse Minkowski5 distances over all centers. Zero-distance rows: equal weight only among exactzero centers; an added convention because paper reciprocal is undefined there. Stable inverse-logit shifting. Native alpha0 output and separately named half-mean adaptation both reported. Native uses U/no information geometry; same selected P, K5 or fewer distinct centers. Model byte count includes selected indices,scaling,feature and label centers, plus prior only for half-adaptation. No complete deployment/hardware-memory claim.

replay_boundary: Existing geometric and oldLloyd, alpha.5 fixed curves and cap100 policies use E07 splits and should replay exactly. Replayed rows are not new independent evidence.
capacity: Same constructor/readout/alpha layout at exactK must have equal numeric array bytes across construction methods. NN5 retains E08 standalone layout. P5 standalone state stores centers,labels,P,lo,span,plus mean only ifalpha>0:8*[K*(d+q)+3d+(q ifalpha>0 else0)]. Thus equalK across different readouts is not necessarily equalbytes. Report actualbytes and fraction against singleton of same readout. Excludes Python/scalar metadata, fitting memory andserialization.
native_anchor: U/paper20/K5/allp5 with no group repair must reproduce E08 nativeLDLKM within1e-12 and bytecounts exactly, alpha0/.5. Mean-reduction array layouts can cause floating-roundoff differences; record observed maxima instead of claiming bitwise identity. Disclosed reconstruction, not author code. Budgeted/G variants are adaptations.
